objective: Detect any normalized-coordinate rounding or C-remainder artifacts near 0 and width boundaries.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the cases on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata.
pass_condition: Pass iff odata[0,0] equals source at (width-1,height-1) for shifts (-1,-1), and shifts (width,height) reproduce the unshifted source exactly.
setup: Run width=2048, height=2048 with shiftX=-1 and shiftY=-1; additionally run shiftX=width and shiftY=height; compute host floor-mod oracle.
